title: Mission control
caption: The overview with a live 3D preview, the session inspector and metrics measured from the running engine. Every metric has a definition and a source.

title: Live Spatial Lab
caption: Scene configuration on the left, the reconstruction in the centre and the inspector on the right. Tracks carry two sigma ellipses; ground truth stays dashed.

title: Unknown is not empty
caption: Amber points mark voxels that no link constrains. The posterior variance separates them from regions that are confidently empty.

title: Doppler spectrogram
caption: Micro Doppler from a walking subject on one link, computed from sanitized channel state. Each column is one frame.

title: Magnitude and phase
caption: Per subcarrier magnitude and sanitized phase for three receive antennas. Frequency selective fading shows as ripples.

title: Twelve stage pipeline
caption: Each stage reports shapes, dtype, measured time and queue state. Channel estimation is marked not applicable because the source already provides CSI.

title: Latency profiling
caption: Processing time and wall clock latency are kept apart. Percentiles only appear once enough samples exist.

title: Three people crossing
caption: Scenario E with link attenuation over time, simulation metrics and an event log that records identity switches.

title: An explained failure
caption: With two nodes there is one link. The model reports insufficient observations and draws nothing rather than inventing a reconstruction.

title: Multipath ghosts
caption: Concrete walls and a coherent back projection model. Reflections put energy where nobody stands.

title: Side by side reconstruction
caption: Ground truth, a baseline model and the current model at the same timestamp with a shared camera.

title: Model registry
caption: Model cards with schemas, confidence semantics, limitations and held out evaluation. Untrained slots are listed but cannot run.

title: Hardware readiness
caption: A live checklist for a physical CSI source, gated on operator authorisation and consent. The adapter is labelled experimental.

title: Reproducible experiments
caption: A saved run with provenance, metric summaries, exports and a replay digest that verifies reproduction.
